in_sanskrit.name: स्रीजन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who creates, produces or brings forth. It is a name for the one who has the power to create, produce or bring forth things. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root 'srj' which means 'to create', 'to produce' or 'to bring forth'.
